items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: we went up there, and Lucky Millinder copied Dave's arrangement, and we re-recorded it with Lucky Millinder's band in Decca Studios.

ctx.x: Right. We went up on a train. Train.
Yeah, but we went up there, and Lucky Millinder copied Dave's arrangement, and we re-recorded it with Lucky Millinder's band in Decca Studios.
